description: This Java class defines an immutable configuration object for message mapping within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides factory methods to create instances with specific configuration properties and conditions, and overrides methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultMessageMapperConfiguration
classes.description: Immutable class representing configuration for message mapping with properties and conditions.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory methods to create instances with provided configuration maps and conditions.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the message mapper configuration.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns a map of configuration properties.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns conditions to check before processing incoming messages.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Returns conditions to check before processing outgoing messages.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on internal fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on internal fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates string representation of the object.
